name: qcbench
description: Code and result files for the paper "Budget-matched benchmarking of machine-learned and model-based quantum control". The archive contains the simulator and the shared budget counter, the five controller implementations compared in the paper (AD-GRAPE, CMA-ES, dCRAB, PPO, and an amortized conditional policy), the measurement and analysis scripts, and every result file underlying the figures and tables of the paper and its Supporting Information. Each figure and each table is regenerated from the included JSON files by the script named in README.md. All algorithms are charged in one currency, forward-equivalent segment propagations, with a gradient evaluation charged at twice the forward cost. Reported quantities are medians over seven independently trained policies with the range across seeds; files produced from a single seed carry a not_quotable field giving the reason. The crossover K*_min is a per-seed minimum over a training-budget grid that brackets it on both sides, and entries that fail that condition are recorded as bounds rather than values. The container images that execute the validation gates are omitted here for size and are available from the author on request.
